Thank you, Manish. Good morning, everyone and warm welcome to Unimech Aerospace and 
Manufacturing Limited's Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings call. Thank you for joining us today. The 
second quarter has been an important period for us as we continue to build on the strong 
momentum witnessed at the start of the year and advance our overreaching strategy, which is 
transforming Unimech into an integrated multi-industry precision engineering platform. 
As indicated during our previous call, Q2 has turned out to be a very strong quarter. In H1 FY 
27, our revenues grew by 85% year-on-year to INR231 crore with significantly strong EBITDA 
margins at 38% for the period. Across our operations, execution remains robust, driven by steady 
order flow and sustained customer demand. 
Concurrently, our strategic initiatives including the seamless integration of Hobel Bellows and 
ramp-up of our production components business are strengthening both our growth prospects 
and operational foundation. This strength is not only visible in our financial performance, but 
also in strengthening our order book and future revenue visibility. 
While our foundational heritage in aerospace tooling has traditionally operated on short cycle 
purchase orders, we have deliberately evolved our business model to establish multi-year 
revenue predictability. By aggressively expanding our precision components and assemblies’ 
business and locking in multi-year long-term supplier agreements with Tier 1s and global OEMs, 
we have fundamentally transformed our growth profile. 
I am pleased to share that as of September 30th, our consolidated order book stands at INR855 
crore representing an increase over of over 700% on a year-on-year basis, successfully building 
high-visibility multi-year compounding revenue streams. To further institutionalize this

momentum and scale these compounding opportunities across our expanding footprint, our long-
term value creation strategy rests on three core pillars: strengthening our core tooling business, 
expanding into higher value recurring manufacturing opportunities across industries under our 
precision components business, investing proactively in capabilities and capacity to capture 
larger multi-year customer programs. 
Let me briefly walk you through our progress across these three pillars.  
Aerospace tooling  
Aero tooling remains our anchor, backed by steady demand across our established engine and 
airframe programs. While traditional tooling operates on a short-term cycle purchase order, we 
are actively expanding into high-visibility contracts. 
For instance, we are negotiating long-term supply agreements with existing customers for high-
demand tools, such as engine stands. Converting such opportunities will allow us to layer 
predictable multi-year revenue streams on top of our agile, short-cycle PO-to-PO business.  
Precision components and assemblies 
Alongside tooling, precision components represent our strongest multi-year growth engine, 
expanding our addressable market across aerospace, defense, semiconductors, capital 
equipment, energy, and nuclear application. Our recent long-term agreements and program 
award wins with OEMs and Tier 1s and global aerospace majors reflect our successful entry into 
the complex aerostructures, engine components, and control systems. 
In semiconductors, our two-year development efforts are bearing fruit, generating some revenue 
in H1 with step-up expected in H2. To demonstrate the sheer strength of our long-term revenue 
pipeline, as of H1 end, we have successfully qualified over 250 parts across our PCA component 
customer base with another 340 plus parts currently in the throughput pipeline. As these parts 
move from qualification into series production, they will provide compounding multi-year 
revenue visibility. In nuclear, our existing order book provides a strong foundation of revenue 
visibility. and we are actively preparing to build on upcoming opportunities.  
Finally, our Middle East expansion through our joint venture with the Kanoo Group in Saudi 
Arabia marks our first international manufacturing footprint in the localized oil and gas market. 
Our initial equity investment of approximately USD4 billion deployed earlier this month fully 
capitalizes this phase, funding the infrastructure readiness required to capture regional 
localization demand.  
Platform expansion and strategic investments  
To capture growing demand tailwinds across aerospace, defense, semiconductor, and industrial 
sectors, we are proactively expanding our manufacturing capabilities. Establishing scale-ready 
capacity early is a critical strategic enabler, sending a clear signal to global OEMs that Unimech 
has the willingness, scale, and technical capability to support their multi-year growth 
requirements.

'26, moving directly into full-scale engine testing to achieve final design approval certification
